prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1024; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If you have already been in contact with our client, please route any future inquiries through this firm.

We request that you disclose the full bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella or excess coverage, together with the declarations pages for each policy.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle data, surveillance or parking lot video, and all correspondence with any party. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and providing the requested information.
